title: Quentin and the Archive
author: E. M. Yarrow
blurb: Jonah Vane, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
